Weekend recap

The best part wasn’t on the scoreboard

From warm-ups to the final whistle, the team hustled, encouraged one another, and enjoyed every minute together.

Our third grade girls played two games over the weekend, against St. Gregory and OLPH St. Catherine. The team brought energy from the opening tip, stayed active on both ends of the court, and kept supporting one another through every possession.

Thank you to the families, coaches, and volunteers who came out to support the team. Your cheers carried through the gym and helped make the weekend special.

Effort, teamwork, and sportsmanship — every trip down the court.

Against St. Gregory, the girls protected the ball under pressure, changed direction with confidence, and kept their eyes up in transition. In the matchup with OLPH St. Catherine, the team listened, regrouped during timeouts, and came back onto the floor ready to work.

The moments captured here tell the story: teammates cheering, players hustling, coaches teaching, and a team growing together.

Moment of the weekend

Listen. Regroup. Go again.

A timeout huddle with Coach Richard and Coach Edison shows the team focused, together, and ready for the next possession.
